repository.note: New source export, not a versioned git checkout. Sources are pinned individually below and in FILES.sha256.

environment.dependencies: Pinned offline cache. Project modules rebuilt cleanly. Full dependency source rebuild not performed.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Every explicit named theorem in audit/declaration_index.json compiles from the included source in Lean; reported axiom dependencies use only the allowed standard axioms. Negative controls are rejected by the compiler or audit as specified.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Universally quantified categories and preadditive categories; abelian groups; normed rings and complete (pseudo)metric spaces; continuous linear maps; an exact ZMod 2 cocycle model. Exact hypotheses appear in the Lean signatures.
mathematics.conventions: Bonding arrows finer to coarser; Lean f ≫ g means g after f; protected semantics p and compatibility residual d are distinct; group-cohomology example is additive.

bounds.universal_theorems: The finite corpus contains universal proofs under their hypotheses. This is not finite numerical evidence substituted for a theorem.

non_claims: No unrestricted pro-category equivalence, universal stack, higher obstruction tower, spectral sequence, or Langlands theorem.
No automatic existence of a residual-reducing correction algorithm for every input.
No independent rebuild of the compiler or mathlib dependency cache.
No claim that the 96 explicit theorem declarations are 96 novel research results.

result: PASS: 14 proof modules, root import and 96 named theorems; all standard-axiom checks and negative controls passed.
residual_risks: Lean compiler and imported cached declarations are trusted; standard axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound are permitted.
